Definition: from G2172; properly, a wish, expressed as a petition to God, or in votive obligation:--prayer, vow.
BiblicalUsage: Euchḗ is prayer — a wish expressed as a petition to God, or a vow made to Him. Paul takes a vow in Acts, and James says the prayer of faith shall save the sick. It is the word for asking God, and for the promise made when He answers.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe euchḗ is the word for prayer as a promise: the wish I lay before God, and the vow I keep when He answers. I hold that prayer is not only asking — it is the promise I make back to Him.
RelatedEvents: Paul's Missionary Journeys; Paul Purifies Himself at the Temple
